title: AI designs physics experiments that outperform human-designed setups
summary: Krenn group (Tübingen, TU Wien and collaborators) treats experiment design as an optimisation problem, using physics simulations to propose and refine setups that yield more precise measurements than human designs across several physics areas. The institutional announcements give no quantitative figures, so the claim rests on the Nature paper, which should be read for the numbers. Evidence strength is therefore unverified from press material alone.
ai_technology: AI-driven optimisation of experimental setups (Krenn group method, simulation-based search)
organization: University of Tübingen; TU Wien; University of Vienna
